label_definition.relevant: The title and abstract directly study registration, alignment, or feature matching between visible/RGB and LWIR/thermal imagery.
label_definition.irrelevant: The paper is adjacent fusion, detection, sensing, medical, RGB-D, or unrelated registration research.

papers.title: Deep RGB-LWIR Image Registration with Cross-Modal Attention
papers.abstract: A visible and long-wave infrared registration network estimates dense alignment.

papers.title: Visible and Thermal Image Alignment under Local Deformation
papers.abstract: The method aligns visible RGB and thermal LWIR image pairs.

papers.title: Infrared-Visible Cross-Modal Feature Matching
papers.abstract: Feature correspondences support registration between RGB and infrared sensors.
papers.label_reason: Direct feature matching for cross-modal registration.

papers.title: Multimodal Image Registration for Low Altitude Platforms
papers.abstract: A survey of visible RGB and LWIR thermal registration for UAV platforms.
papers.label_reason: Directly surveys the target registration setting.

papers.title: Visible-Infrared Registration for Historical Document Enhancement
papers.abstract: An adaptive method registers visible and thermal images before enhancement.

papers.title: Cross-Sensor Alignment of RGB and Long-Wave Infrared Cameras
papers.abstract: The paper estimates geometric registration between visible and LWIR cameras.

papers.title: Visible-Infrared Image Fusion for Object Detection
papers.abstract: A thermal and RGB image fusion network improves object detection accuracy.
papers.label_reason: Fusion and detection without registration contribution.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Medical Thermal Imaging
papers.abstract: Infrared sensing supports medical diagnosis from thermal images.

papers.title: Multispectral YOLO Object Detection: A Survey
papers.abstract: Visible and infrared imagery are fused for multispectral object detection.

papers.title: A Review of Visible and Infrared Image Fusion
papers.abstract: The review compares thermal-visible image fusion strategies.

papers.title: RGB-D Point Cloud Registration
papers.abstract: RGB and depth camera point clouds are aligned for 3D reconstruction.

papers.title: Satellite Image Registration with Feature Descriptors
papers.abstract: Optical satellite images are aligned across acquisition dates.
